column3: Maybe if I meditate\nharder, I'll turn\nback into a man...{page_break}Ngg{pause_20_skippable} Ung!!{pause_20_skippable} Ugagaga!!!{end_wait}
Who did this?\nSomeone must have tried\nto cut down Tret!{end_wait}
How do I charge for\nrooms if I'm a tree?{end_wait}

The villagers were right.
I never should have tried
to cut that tree down.{page_break}Now I'll never see
my family in Imil
again...{end_wait}
If only I'd left town\na day earlier. But this\nroom was so comfortable.{end_wait}
This is Kolima,\nvillage of lumberjacks.\nI'll say it out loud.{page_break}This{pause_20_skippable} is{pause_20_skippable} Ko{pause_20_skippable}li{pause_20_skippable}ma.{end_wait}
I didn't mind being\na tree...{page_break}It was quiet. Nothing\nhurt.{end_wait}
Yawn... Trees are so...\nsleepy...{end_wait}

For a while I thought I'd
never speak again,
but I can say it now.{page_break}I've waited my whole
life for this moment.{end_wait}
I wonder if I'd have\nlived longer as\na tree.{end_wait}
If those sparkles start\nfalling again, I'm\nheading for the hills.{end_wait}
If we were all trees,\nthere'd be no more wars.{pause_20_skippable}\nNo more of anything.{end_wait}
Nobody yells at you when\nyou're a tree...{page_break}And nobody asks you\nfor anything.{end_wait}

You saved Kolima? I'd
like to tell you a
secret.{page_break}But not yet. Some
secrets are only safe
with me.{end_wait}
It's hidden deep in\nthe forest, but I can't\ntell him I know!{end_wait}
Dad! How will we eat\nif you don't work?{end_wait}
How will I grow up\nif I don't eat?{page_break}If he won't feed me,\nI won't listen to him!{end_wait}
A shame we cut down\nso many trees for that\nbridge.{end_wait}
When I was a tree,\nI learned to value\nthe sun.{end_wait}
It felt wonderful when\nmy leaves were bathed\nin sunlight.{end_wait}
They say the holy tree's\nrage caused this horror...{page_break}Do you believe that\nwas the only cause?{end_now}
You may not have noticed,\nbut something changed\nwhen those gems landed.{end_wait}
I agree. Something did\nchange when the gems fell.{end_wait}

I've been a lumberjack
for years and never saw
anything like this.{page_break}I think I'll go home
to my family in Imil.{end_wait}

I'm only a merchant, but
I was turned into a tree
just for staying here.{page_break}I'll head to Xian,
south of the river, now
that I'm a man again.{end_wait}

I wish I'd grabbed some
of those gems that fell
from the sky.{page_break}They must be
worth a fortune.{end_wait}

I think I now know what
it means to sink roots
in one place.{page_break}I wouldn't recommend
it.{end_wait}
I can't even believe\nit myself.{end_wait}
Amazing! You broke the\nso-called curse.{end_wait}
I didn't think so. You\ndon't look very tough\nat all.{end_wait}

Then how did the people
who became trees come
back to normal?{page_break}Did we imagine
the whole thing?{end_wait}

Even heroes like
you can feel fear.{page_break}Imagine how scary
it was for us poor
townsfolk.{end_wait}

You can say that now,
because it's over.{page_break}At the time, we were
all scared out of
our wits.{end_wait}
Two specials! One dinner!\nOne sandwich! One\ndessert! Hurry up!{end_wait}
I really think the\nhead chef has changed.\nIt's too much.{end_wait}
I can't keep up\nwith his energy.{end_wait}
I'm surprised the head\nchef is working so\nhard.{end_wait}

They served so much food
today.{page_break}If they do that every
day, they won't make
any money.{end_wait}
That was some meal.\nDon't you just love\nthe food here?{end_now}
I know how you feel.\nFind a table and\neat your fill.{end_wait}
What? Why am I talking\nto you when I could be\neating?{end_wait}
Ooooh...{pause_20_skippable} That's it...\nI tried my best, but I\ncouldn't eat another bite.{end_wait}
Well, I only acted\nscared to fit in.\nI wasn't really scared.{end_wait}
It'd be better for\nbusiness if the curse\nhadn't broken so fast.{end_wait}

I'll go to Kolima when
the customers are gone.{page_break}Until then, I'll cook
like there's no
tomorrow.{end_wait}

The head chef was so
lazy until a few days
ago, but all of{page_break}a sudden I can't keep
up with how much he's
changed.{end_wait}
It used to take them\nforever to serve, but\nnot anymore.{end_wait}

When they stopped
building the palace, I
lost all my business.{page_break}Maybe I'll buy silk in
Xian and sell it in Tolbi.{end_wait}
I wish I could eat like\nthis all the time.{end_wait}
I'd better eat a lot;\nthat chef will burn out\nat this rate.{end_wait}
The food is a good\nvalue at this price.{end_wait}
If a kid like this could\nend the curse, maybe I\ncould have done it.{end_wait}
Visit me anytime.{pause_20_skippable} Yeh'll\nalways find a hearth\nhere.{end_wait}
Don't be so harsh...{pause_20_skippable}\nJust say yes, even if\nyou don't mean it.{end_wait}
Don't leave, {actor_name:1}!\nBe my mentor, and\nteach me to be brave.{end_wait}

I heard you received
a spectacular reward.{page_break}I hope it shows how
kind Lord McCoy can
be.{end_wait}

Lady McCoy is upset
that construction on
the palace halted.{page_break}You probably won't want
to approach her for
a while.{end_wait}
